release_notes: Factburst Quiz Manager now publishes a signed Windows release automatically whenever a new desktop version is merged to main.
The Updates button can bootstrap the signed installer when the app is still being run from a development or source folder.
After the one-time installer handoff, future Updates checks use Velopack to download, apply and restart into the newest release automatically.
The installed product is now presented as Factburst Quiz Manager while preserving the existing FactVaultManager package ID for upgrade compatibility.
The legacy Production header button is guarded immediately against becoming visible during Refresh, eliminating the brief flicker seen in Build 49.
Release versions are read directly from version.json so GitHub releases, the installer and the desktop build stay on the same 1.0.x version line.
